how_generated: 64 tokens; at every position from index 4 on, 16 candidates are drawn and the one whose n-gram carries the most g-bits wins (random.Random(seed=4104)). This reproduces SynthID tournament sampling with a uniform proposal distribution.
why_it_matters: The sharp one: genuinely watermarked, mean-g well above the upper threshold, but under MIN_TOKENS. It must STILL be skipped. Length gating has to run before the statistic, or the tool reports a verdict it cannot defend -- and the same gate that protects against false positives has to cost us this true positive.
